Combining enhanced-sampling molecular dynamics with NMR data identifies low-population, pocket-containing HIV-1 TAR substates that overlap with ligand-bound structures and provide a framework for structure-based drug discovery.

#### [Benchmarking Deep Learning Predictions of Mutation-Induced Fold Switching](<https://www.biorxiv.org/content/10.64898/2026.08.02.742283v1>)
*Felbinger, N.; Carillo, K. J.; Chen, Y.; Orban, J.; Pierce, B.* <br>
Evaluation of structure prediction algorithms against a new NMR-characterized GA/GB mutant dataset demonstrates that AlphaFold2-based tools achieve site-specific success but face significant position-dependent limitations in quantifying how point mutations shift conformational populations.

#### [Biophysical characterization of novel biomarkers and bioaffinity reagents (NanoMIPs): on the road for a low-cost diagnostic test for intestinal schistosomiasis](<https://www.biorxiv.org/content/10.64898/2026.07.28.741194v1>)
*Isopo, F.; Stephen, A. N.; Boumis, G.; Giorgi, A.; Eberini, I.; Reddy, S. M.; Miele, A. E.* <br>
SmVAL11 and SmVAL13 exhibit high selectivity for both specific antibodies and synthetic nanoMIPs, establishing a more sensitive and reliable foundation for monitoring *S. mansoni* infections than current standard methods.

#### [Dengue virus 2 lacking N153 glycosylation displayed enhanced recognition by neutralizing antibodies](<https://www.biorxiv.org/content/10.64898/2026.07.31.741530v1>)
*Fibriansah, G.; Ng, T.-S.; Lim, X.-N.; Tan, A. W. K.; Ting, D. H. R.; Screaton, G. R.; Crowe, J. E.; Alonso, S.; Lok, S.-M.* <br>
Increased epitope accessibility and slower antibody dissociation rates drive the higher Fab occupancy and potent neutralization of the N153Q mutant, highlighting its potential as a vaccine candidate.

#### [Molecular Hyperpolarisability as a Screening Descriptor for Second-Order Nonlinear Optics in Ferroelectric Nematic Liquid Crystals](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2607.27986v1>)
*Charles Parton-Barr, Nerea Sebastian, Richard Mandle* <br>
Density functional theory calculations benchmarked against experimental data establish that relative performance trends can effectively identify high-performance candidates and reveal structural design rules centered on molecular asymmetry and conjugation length.
